_about: Task 11.21 Step 4: the 50 campaign personas (plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-24-notebook-widgets-p2-w11.md). `data` is read by seed_members.py; `scripts` by run_campaign.py. Every expected sentence names the file:line it is read from and the exact `fragment` that must still be in that file; run_campaign.py checks each one against the source before a run and refuses a drifted sentence (a sentence is quoted, never a second authority). `needs`: w11 = a wave 11 backend route (reported INCONCLUSIVE when the server lacks it), restart = a flag flip (needs a sandbox the runner owns), clock = the launcher-only clock shift (sandbox_clock.py, ruling W11-R49; INCONCLUSIVE without --clock-launcher; `clock` is one ISO instant or a list, a script's `at` names one); `once` = the script runs in the persona's first run only. `validated`: the served run that drove the script end to end, its run verdicts, the triage that classified every FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE step, and what changed in the script since (W11-R81). `single_step_why`: why one step is the whole test.

personas.clock_note: Sunday 21:00 ET (Mon 02:00Z) binds to Mon Nov 23 (a UTC note day would give Tue). Tuesday 21:00 ET (Wed 02:00Z) binds to Wed Nov 25 (a UTC note day would give Fri: Thursday is closed). The eve of Thanksgiving, Wednesday 23:30 ET, binds to Fri Nov 27 either way, so the ET-vs-UTC trap is carried by the first two instants.
